title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Develop a scheduling system specifically tailored for a brass band, allowing conductors to schedule rehearsals, track section-by-section attendance, check venue availability, and select repertoire.
latestMessage: Develop a scheduling system specifically tailored for a brass band, allowing conductors to schedule rehearsals, track section-by-section attendance, check venue availability, and select repertoire.

steps.title: Integrate calendar API for venue booking availability
steps.instruction: Connect the scheduling backend to the shared venue Google Calendar to read existing bookings and prevent conflicts.
steps.acceptance: System can fetch calendar events and flag overlapping time slots in the scheduler.

steps.title: Add instrumentation requirements to rehearsal events
steps.instruction: Implement a feature allowing conductors to specify which instrument sections (e.g., Trombones and Tubas only) are required for a particular rehearsal slot.
steps.acceptance: Conductors can select specific sections when creating a rehearsal, and notifications are only sent to those players.

steps.title: Design database schema for band member attendance tracking
steps.instruction: Create a database schema to track player attendance (Attending, Absent, Late) for scheduled rehearsals, linking players to their instrument sections.
steps.acceptance: Schema supports querying attendance by rehearsal, by player, or by section. Migration script runs successfully on development database.
steps.result: Database migration file 003_attendance_tracking.sql successfully generated and executed on the development database. Verified table structure for attendance and members with correct foreign key constraints. Queries for section-wise attendance are performing under 10ms.

steps.title: Create email notification template for rehearsal updates
steps.instruction: Design and implement a transactional email template to notify band members of newly scheduled rehearsals or timing changes.
steps.acceptance: Template displays date, time, venue, and required repertoire, including RSVP buttons.
steps.result: Created HTML and text templates in templates/rehearsal_notification.html. Integrated RSVP endpoints (/api/rsvp/confirm and /api/rsvp/decline) as action buttons. Tested email rendering successfully across major clients.

steps.title: Develop API endpoint for repertoire selection
steps.instruction: Build a REST API endpoint (GET /api/repertoire) that lists the active pieces in the band's library to allow scheduling specific pieces for rehearsal slots.
steps.acceptance: Endpoint returns a list of pieces filtered by difficulty, composer, or status.
steps.result: Implemented GET /api/repertoire controller with query parameter filters. Added unit tests verifying response payloads and pagination logic. Code merged into main branch.

steps.title: Implement conflict resolution for multi-booked instrument sections
steps.instruction: Write validation logic to prevent scheduling a player for two different sectional rehearsals at the same time.
steps.acceptance: Scheduler throws a validation error if a player's section is already booked in an overlapping timeframe.
steps.result: Added validation middleware checkSectionAvailability in the scheduling route. Tested overlapping scenarios for Cornet and Horn sections; conflict exceptions are correctly raised and returned as structured JSON errors to the client.
